symptom: Parameters without @position were written at 200;53, 300;53, 400;53 whatever their names, so LongParameterNameOne/Two/Three (20-22 characters) overlapped on the canvas. describe prints no parameter positions, so nothing headless showed it.
cause: DerivedParameterPosition(idx) returned 200 + idx*100; the MCP backend repeated the same arithmetic inline
file: sdk/microflows/microflows.go (ParameterPitch, DerivedParameterPosition, AuthoredParameterPosition, legacyParameterPosition), mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow.go (splitFlowObjects, now two-pass), microflow_write.go, nanoflow_write.go, rule_write.go, mdl/backend/mcp/microflow.go, mdl/executor parameter sites
insight: The pitch now depends on every name, so the reader must read all parameters before deciding which positions are authored (splitFlowObjects is two-pass). The trap the reporter flagged is real: AuthoredParameterPosition compares against the derived point, so without also accepting the OLD 100px row every long-named parameter an earlier mxcli wrote would read as hand-placed and stay overlapped. Fitted to 95 Studio Pro-authored parameter rows (median pitch 95/106/125/160px for names of 5-9/10-14/15-19/20-24 characters): ~7px a character, rounded up to 10, floor 100 — names under 15 characters keep the old row, so ordinary flows do not move. 73% of 1,109 multi-parameter Studio Pro flows stack parameters in a COLUMN (median pitch 95px) instead; switching to that would move every generated flow's parameters and was not done.
